text: 金融监管总局召开党委（扩大）会议，传达学习党的二十届五中全会精神，结合金融监管工作实际，研究部署贯彻落实措施。会议强调，要以高质量党建引领金融监管高质量发展。稳妥推进中小金融机构改革化险、减量提质，积极支持配合化解房地产和地方政府债务风险。坚持严监管强监管，坚守监管姓监定位，做到严格监管、专注监管，不断提升监管有效性。持续推动行业改革转型，督促机构树牢正确的经营观、业绩观、风险观，引导行业围绕“十五五”规划纲要重点任务，优化金融资源配置，持续提升金融服务适配性。
text_en: The National Financial Regulatory Administration held an enlarged Party Committee meeting to convey and study the spirit of the Fifth Plenary Session of the 20th CPC Central Committee and, in light of the reality of financial regulatory work, study and deploy measures for implementation. The meeting emphasized the need to lead high-quality development of financial regulation with high-quality Party building. It called for steadily advancing the reform, risk resolution, reduction in number and improvement in quality of small and medium-sized financial institutions, and actively supporting and cooperating in defusing risks in real estate and local government debt. It stressed adherence to strict and strong regulation,坚守 the positioning that regulation is regulation, achieving strict regulation and focused regulation, and continuously improving regulatory effectiveness. It also urged continued efforts to promote industry reform and transformation, urge institutions to firmly establish correct views on operation, performance and risk, and guide the industry to focus on the key tasks of the 15th Five-Year Plan outline, optimize the allocation of financial resources, and continuously improve the adaptability of financial services.
